description: This file defines the EndpointDiscoveryMiddleware class, which handles endpoint discovery logic for AWS SDK HTTP requests, including caching, endpoint resolution, error handling, and request modification.

classes.name: EndpointDiscoveryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that manages AWS endpoint discovery, including caching, endpoint resolution, and request modification for AWS SDK commands.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to wrap a client, args, and config into a middleware handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with handler, client, args, and config.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware invocation method that handles endpoint discovery, cache checking, error handling, and request modification.

methods.name: discoverEndpoint
methods.description: Performs endpoint discovery by executing a discovery command and caching the result.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on credentials, command, and identifiers.

methods.name: getDiscoveryCommand
methods.description: Builds the command for endpoint discovery based on operation and identifiers.

methods.name: getIdentifiers
methods.description: Resolves identifiers from operation shape for endpoint discovery.

methods.name: handleDiscoveryException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during endpoint discovery, throws if required or uses original URI.

methods.name: handleInvalidEndpoint
methods.description: Handles invalid endpoints by updating cache and retrying discovery if necessary.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request URI and headers with the discovered endpoint.

methods.name: parseEndpoint
methods.description: Parses an endpoint URI into host and path components.

methods.name: useOriginalUri
methods.description: Resets request to use the original URI if endpoint discovery isn't required or fails.
